note: Scott County Conservation recreation area on the Mississippi River downstream of Buffalo. Concrete patios; river sites along the front row. Free public beach and boat ramp. --Claude
summary: Rates added $27/$30; 65 sites, 50 amp + water, FCFS, showers, dump confirmed; max 14; season late Apr-mid Oct is approximate so no dates. Riverfront stands; pin fine.
flags: WATERFRONT: riverfront stands. County: 'Scenic beachfront sites', '17 River Sites', a $30 'Riverview' rate. Imagery (0.24 m/px): the bottom row's pads run south off the last lane with about 30 m of open sand and scattered trees to the Mississippi, no road between. One open question: the county's 'free public beach' (a separate page, with volleyball and parking) doesn't say where it is. The big lots and courts are at the east end, past the campground, but the same sand runs on along the front of the sites, so if the beach is in use there it is day use in the apron and the call would be riverview. No site map found. Rail and Hwy 22 pass about 150 m north.
